body.objective: Construct or exactly obstruct a strictly four-dimensional Diff-covariant regulator architecture for the dressed metric plus algebraic Weyl quartet, complementary to the active d-dimensional evanescent DR/MS route and still parametrized by the later selected Candidate A or B Hessian.
body.stop_condition: Import the exact finite-carrier dressed BV Berezinian obstruction and TAU_ADIC_DR_MS_QAP_EVANESCENT_CLOSURE_OBSTRUCTION by content hash. Declare a complete bounded family of genuinely four-dimensional covariant regulators suitable for a fourth-order gauge theory, including higher-covariant-derivative plus Pauli-Villars and/or a matched proper-time/heat-kernel construction, with primal/dual projectors, BRST-compatible regulator fields, quartet treatment, real contours, zero-mode slots, and boundary-domain slots. Derive the regulated canonical-map Jacobian and one-loop Ward breaking symbolically far enough to prove one of: a local Diff-BRST-compatible receiver exists for every selected Hessian satisfying explicit symbol hypotheses; the regulator family necessarily violates the quartet/canonical pairing; or the first exact missing action-dependent datum. Compare its subtraction ambiguity with the active evanescent DR/MS module without identifying the schemes. Export strict Candidate A scalar and Candidate B reducible-three-form receiver slots, mutation tests, an independent verifier, and a theorem-boundary report. Stop before importing an unselected action, computing its determinant coefficients, asserting QAP/all-loop QME, or making Lorentzian/state/particle claims.
body.current_gate: action-independent strictly four-dimensional regulator alternative after the nonunit Berezinian and DR/MS evanescence obstructions
body.forbid: no formal canonical transformation called measure preserving; no unregulated product of determinants; no regulator mass or contour chosen from convenience without BV/real-structure checks; no dimensional Euler identity imported into a four-dimensional scheme comparison; no action-independent zero-mode or boundary claim; no QAP, all-loop QME, global anomaly, Hadamard, positivity, particle, scattering or unitarity promotion
activates: a regulator-route comparison after the evanescent preflight
or an exact no-go for the declared four-dimensional regulator family
body.resource_hint: SECOND IMMEDIATE QUANTUM RESERVE. Run after the active evanescent module if Candidate A/B is still unresolved; it is a complementary regulator architecture, not a duplicate coefficient calculation.
